experiment: HLS-S4 Bayesian estimation × certainty-equivalent Bellman planning

definitions.reward: sum of real pre-transition competence over assigned pairs
definitions.frozen: no observation likelihood updates; posterior is propagated through known MIS-v2 after executed actions
definitions.updated: assimilate noisy observations from executed pairs, then propagate posterior through MIS-v2
definitions.prior: same uniform discrete prior in every cell and condition; mean 0.5
definitions.bellman: existing exact S4 recursion replanned from posterior mean and known remaining demand; certainty-equivalent, not Bayesian-optimal
definitions.reactive: existing exact immediate S4 assignment from the same posterior mean
definitions.pairing: same seed-indexed observation noise streams across four conditions; action-dependent observed pairs may differ
definitions.ci: paired replicate means with normal-approximation 95% intervals (1.96 × SE), seeds are units
